role: Robotics AI Engineer – Calibration, Localization, and Mapping

adjacent_skills.you_have: Software calibration of tap sensor, ToF range-gating

key_responsibilities: Design calibration, localization, mapping algorithms for quadrupeds and humanoids
Build validation and benchmarking tools and metrics
Integrate and deploy into real systems

strengths: 3D frame/pose math is real: Frame Simulator wrote a custom SE(3) engine (local/world composition, recursive transform chaining, 4x4 inspection) in Python
Kinematics depth: hand-derived DH tables and full forward-kinematic chains for UR5e (6-DoF) and AL5B, validated against MoveIt/RViz in ROS 2 Humble and Noetic; two-link IK in C++ on the capstone arm
Geometric vision exposure at BARC: homography stitching and ZoeDepth monocular depth for 3D crack-surface reconstruction (±8% error)
Runs perception under compute limits on Jetson (TensorRT YOLO 56.7 to 10.9 ms) with systemd-deployed ROS-adjacent services and Git/GitLab
real_gaps: No localization or mapping of any kind: no LiDAR, no visual-inertial odometry, no SLAM, no point clouds, no factor graphs
No state estimation: no Kalman/EKF/UKF, particle filter, or probabilistic modelling anywhere in the profile
No sensor calibration in the JD's sense (camera intrinsics, LiDAR/camera/IMU extrinsics, hand-eye) and no time synchronization work
Lie theory and numerical optimization are absent beyond SE(3) composition: no manifold calculus, no nonlinear least squares or bundle adjustment
ROS is used as a consumer (UR driver, MoveIt, RViz); no evidence of designing and deploying own nodes in a complex robotic system
C++ evidence is Arduino-level IK and CUDA kernels, not modern-C++ library or algorithm code
No publications or patents, no radar/GPS/doppler-LiDAR, no outlier-resilient estimation (RANSAC, robust loss)
overstated_by_keywords: State estimation / sensor fusion counted Adjacent: the capstone ToF is a threshold range-gate, not fusion with any filter or covariance
LiDAR-inertial odometry and SLAM counted Adjacent: Robocon encoder dead-reckoning is wheel odometry for heading hold and CARLA work is detection and lane-following, neither localizes in a map
ROS counted Have: depth is arm driver and MoveIt use, weaker than the JD's 'designing, building, deploying your own nodes'
Sensor calibration counted Adjacent: ADXL345 tap-threshold tuning is not intrinsics/extrinsics calibration
understated_by_keywords: BARC homography stitching plus monocular depth is genuine multi-view geometry experience that matches no keyword here
Frame Simulator is the strongest single proof for the 3D geometry and transform-chain side of the JD (frame hierarchies are what extrinsics are)
screening_gaps: No localization, SLAM or odometry experience (LiDAR-inertial or visual-inertial) when that is the team's entire product
No state estimation or probabilistic/optimization foundation (Kalman family, factor graphs, Lie-group optimization)
No sensor calibration or time synchronization experience, and ROS depth is as a user rather than a node author
llm_analysis.reasoning: The role is a state-estimation and SLAM specialist seat on a small team, and the profile has solid kinematics, SE(3) math and perception-on-edge work but nothing in localization, filtering, calibration or mapping, which is the core of every responsibility. The transferable pieces (SE(3) engine, DH/FK, ROS, geometric vision) get you past a resume skim for a robotics role in general but not past a CLAM-team technical screen. Keyword scoring slightly flatters the fit by crediting threshold gating and wheel odometry as sensor fusion and LiDAR odometry.
